question:
(i) State Faraday’s law of electromagnetic induction for a coil of $N$ turns.
(ii) A coil of $250$ turns has the magnetic flux linked with each turn changing uniformly from $5.0 \times 10^{-4}\text{ Wb}$ to $1.0 \times 10^{-4}\text{ Wb}$ in $0.04\text{ s}$. Calculate the magnitude of the average induced emf.

options.A:
(i) Faraday’s law for a coil is $|\varepsilon|=\left|\dfrac{\Delta\Phi_B}{\Delta t}\right|$.
(ii) $0.01\text{ V}$
options.B:
(i) Faraday’s law for a coil is $|\varepsilon|=N\left|\dfrac{\Delta\Phi_B}{\Delta t}\right|$.
(ii) $1.0\text{ V}$
options.C:
(i) Faraday’s law for a coil is $|\varepsilon|=N\left|\dfrac{\Phi_2+\Phi_1}{\Delta t}\right|$.
(ii) $3.75\text{ V}$
options.D:
(i) Faraday’s law for a coil is $|\varepsilon|=N\left|\dfrac{\Delta\Phi_B}{\Delta t}\right|$.
(ii) $2.5\text{ V}$
